purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - individual receipt data display/instruction screen (レセ電データ個別指示) for monthly billing
purpose.summary: ORCGT06 is a screen-handling program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that manages individual receipt data display and instruction (レセ電データ個別指示). It processes screen transitions, initializes display data, handles user input events via the MCP framework, and coordinates with job management and DB access copybooks to support monthly medical billing receipt processing.

notable_features: MCP framework (MCP-STATUS, MCP-EVENT, MCP-WINDOW) - ORCA-specific middleware
53 COPY statements with .INC includes (ORCA copybook architecture)
255 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCA DB access layer (MCPDATA.INC)
Screen area includes T01-T99 screen copybooks
verdict.notes: Source file is 4512 lines, truncated at 16000 chars in this view. Japanese comments are garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The ORCA MCP framework is a proprietary middleware layer used in JMA ORCA, not standard CICS, but the program_type is analogous to online/screen-driven processing. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial domain, likely using display numerics throughout.
